review:
Bullets and Bounty, turned up. The DuelReels, Bounty duels and 20,000x max are the same, but Hacksaw says volatility is higher, the BonusHunt FeatureSpins mode hits bonuses more often, and you can gamble your way up into the Epic Bonus.

If you've played the original and want something more extreme, this is it. If you're new to both, start with the original – and either way, the demo is the cheapest way to see how often a Bounty chain really comes together.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
